subject: Implementation roadmap + demo timing and environment prep
messages:
From: Tom Harris <tharris@lumenbyte.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyanka Agarwal <prianka@lumenbyte.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up — request for technical deep-dive

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the discovery session today — that was helpful. We'd like to move to the next step: a technical deep-dive focused on integration / deployment considerations (networking, KV cache behavior, and data handling).

Target outcomes:
- Confirm model variant and quantization options for our latency requirements
- Review private deployment options (VPC) and what evidence you'll need for our security team
- Walk through a proposed pre-production runbook and test-data plan

Attendees from our side will be me (Tom), Priyanka (SRE lead), and one of our infra architects (TBD).

Can you propose 1–2 90-minute windows in the next week? We are PST-based (San Francisco). Also please send any pre-read (runbook/checklist) we should review.

Appreciate it —
Tom

Tom Harris
Head of Platform Engineering, LumenByte
tharris@lumenbyte.com
+1 (415) 555-0127
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Harris <tharris@lumenbyte.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T17:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up — request for technical deep-dive

Tom — thanks for the clear outcomes. Happy to run the session and map to a practical runbook. Proposed slots (all PT):

- Wednesday 2027-05-05 09:30–11:00
- Thursday 2027-05-06 13:00–14:30

If neither works, we can do Friday morning.

Prep I need from your side before the session:
- A short list of your expected peak seq lengths / token rates and a sample workload profile (can be anonymized)
- Network topology constraints (e.g., egress IPs, VPN/Direct Connect)
- Any internal compliance checklist items that need to be covered (SOC2 section numbers, logging retention)

I'll attach the Redwood demo runbook draft and a short pre-demo checklist — it includes what we'll request for access and a template for scoped test data. Marissa (cc'd) will help coordinate calendar and ops support.

If you want, we can make the session a working meeting (we'll bring a sample workload and run short latency traces).

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Priyanka Agarwal <prianka@lumenbyte.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Harris <tharris@lumenbyte.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up — request for technical deep-dive

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the options. We can do Wednesday 2027-05-05 09:30–11:00 PT. That time works for SRE and infra. We attached a short NDAP (network/data access policy) summary for the session — see lumenbyte-ndap-requirements.pdf.

A couple quick notes for your runbook:
- We'll need steps for establishing a temporary test subnet and a minimal inbound rule set so we can run a short end-to-end call from our test agents.
- Our security team will want to see where audit logs live and retention windows (30/90/365 days options).
- We have production-like sample traces but cannot share PII; we will provide sanitized traces.

Tom will send the calendar invite; please confirm any VPN credentials or jump host details you need ahead of time.

Thanks —
Priyanka
Priyanka Agarwal
SRE Lead, LumenByte
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Harris <tharris@lumenbyte.com>, Priyanka Agarwal <prianka@lumenbyte.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation roadmap + demo timing and environment prep

On Sat, May 1, 2027 at 3:12 PM Tom Harris <tharris@lumenbyte.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the discovery session today — that was helpful. We'd like to move to the next step: a technical deep-dive focused on integration / deployment considerations (networking, KV cache behavior, and data handling).

Confirmed: Wednesday 2027-05-05 09:30–11:00 PT (90 mins) as a working deep-dive. Calendar invite should arrive from Tom.

Attached: redwood-demo-runbook.pdf (short, 6 pages) — highlights in the runbook:
- Pre-demo checklist (access, sample payloads, test subnets)
- Suggested session agenda (15 min architecture review, 45 min hands-on validation, 20 min action items + rollouts)
- Minimal data access matrix we request during the run (sanitized traces are fine)

Operational notes / asks for the session:
1) Please provision a temporary test subnet with 1 NAT egress and allow outbound to the following Redwood egress IPs: 52.157.12.34, 52.157.12.35 (we'll use TLS/443).
2) If you plan to route via a jump host, please share SSH fingerprint and jump host IP 24 hours prior.
3) If access to a sample S3 bucket is required, provide an IAM role or short-lived credentials with limited read-only scope.

Marissa — can you own the Zoom link and bring ops runbook during the call? Evelyn — FYI on post-demo readiness and any dedicated capacity conversations (we may surface Dedicated as an option if throughput shows need).

Next steps:
- I will upload the runbook to the Drive link and post a HubSpot note against deal LUM-2027-042.
- Priyanka/Tom: please confirm the subnet/egress window and drop sanitized traces into the Drive folder by EOD Tuesday.

Looking forward to it.

—
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
redwoodinference.com | ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
